build_RLEHead: build an RLEHead instance with specified input channels and number of joints for pose regression
forward_RLEHead: run the forward pass of RLEHead on multi-scale feature maps to predict keypoint coordinates and sigma
predict_RLEHead: predict keypoint coordinates from feature maps with optional flip test TTA augmentation
loss_RLEHead: calculate regression loss and PCK accuracy for a batch of predicted keypoints and ground truth labels
review_RLEHead_load_state_dict_hook: review the _load_state_dict_pre_hook method that converts old-version state dict keys to the new loss_module format
